question: BDBF is related to JLJN in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, HJHL is related to PRPT. To which of the given options is RTRV related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/caa61e0e1e127da3932154a0db30a0fa604afb145e3954b5fdfa2e7c2f0c0f43.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, BDBF → JLJN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e09640c97d7797d54bb4684146df81ac37c9ff26959cb54f536fa3644aa40910.png] 

For, HJHL → PRPT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ce07fc1e45a49af0b5b5363fbb5cfa778bd2ce5169f8c6631b179e2d0e4eb52.png] 

Now, apply the same to RTRV:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fa972401526d2a92b527f7a4dda18a3ee3749404ca75ec520e2767a9eff4e33.png] 

So, RTRV → ZBZD

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
